title: Minimum Number of Keypresses
summary: Given a string s , determine the minimum number of keypresses required to type it using a keypad with 9 buttons.
statement: Given a string s , determine the minimum number of keypresses required to type it using a keypad with 9 buttons. Each button can be mapped to up to 3 unique lowercase English letters, with each character mapped to exactly one button, and all 26 lowercase English letters must be covered. To type the first character mapped to a button, press the button once; for the second character, press it twice, and so on.
constraints: Nine buttons each provide a one-press, two-press, and three-press letter slot.
Every lowercase letter is assigned exactly once, but only characters occurring in s contribute cost.
Minimize total keypresses across all occurrences of s.
hints: Letter identities do not matter after their frequencies are known.
Assign larger frequencies to cheaper slots: nine cost-one slots, then nine cost-two slots, then eight cost-three slots.
Sort frequencies descending and sum frequency*(index//9+1).
Swapping a more frequent letter out of a costlier slot never increases cost, proving the sorted greedy assignment.
editorial: Swapping a more frequent letter out of a costlier slot never increases cost, proving the sorted greedy assignment.

tests.explanation: Assigning its four used letters to one-press slots makes all five characters cost one press.
Nine letters cost one press and three cost two, totaling fifteen.
